text:
Maya: heads up, deploy-bot just flagged the r3.14 rollout. vuln scan found a HIGH in third_party 'fastparse' (lib v2.0). deploy bot suggests hold. anyone oncall?

deploy-bot: [AUTO] release=r3.14 stage=canary scan=vuln result=HIGH id=CVE-2026-9999 path=lib/fastparse severity=HIGH recommended_action=hold_more_info_url=https://scanner.local/2061239876

Liam: i'll take this. quick question — is this path actually used by our inference runtime or only by a dev tool?

Maya: runtime uses a thin wrapper around fastparse for input sanitization on the hosted API path. not used in dedicated/private runtime AFAIK.

Nitya (security): can you paste the scanner output? need exploitability + fixed versions. if there's a patch we can consider a quick hotpatch + re-scan.

Liam: paste from scanner: ```
Affected: lib/fastparse@2.0
Vuln: CVE-2026-9999
Severity: HIGH
Exploitability: HIGH (remote parsing of crafted payload)
Fix: 2.0.1 contains a patch
References: https://vulndb.local/CVE-2026-9999
```

Zoe (product): this is mid-day in our change window and we have a marketing push. if we stall customers will see feature toggles. what's the blast radius?

Maya: blast radius limited to hosted API text input endpoints. canary is in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 currently; eu-west-1 has 3% traffic.

Liam: proposal: pause global rollout, isolate canary to eu-west-1 only (traffic=1%), push hotpatch that pins fastparse to 2.0.1 and rebuild, then re-run vuln scan. if scan clears, continue gradual rollout.

Nitya (security): pinning is ok but we need signature verification of the artifact and SBOM update. also want a short mitigations doc in thread. If build artifacts are signed and scanner passes, security will +1.

Maya: signing status: CI artifacts currently signed by CI-KMS key. I will attach the artifact digest once build finishes.

Oncall Bot: change-window: standard window ends in 3h. Requesting extension? Use `/change-window extend 1h --reason "security hotpatch & verification"`

Zoe (product): please extend, marketing notified. delay release notes until we confirm.

Liam: i'm starting the hotpatch branch now, will run a canary limited to eu-west-1. command: `redwoodctl release create r3.14-hotpatch --pin lib/fastparse@sha256:2f3a... --regions eu-west-1 --traffic 0.01`

Maya: also updating SBOM with pinned digest: `sbom-tool update --package fastparse --version 2.0.1 --digest sha256:2f3a...` then push signed SBOM to artifacts.

Nitya (security): once you push signed SBOM and CI scan returns clean, post the scanner URL and i'll review. If exploitability drops to MED and no active exploit, we can approve immediate continuation.

Liam: build done, artifacts signed. scanner re-run in progress — ETA ~8m. digest sha256:2f3a7b9c... pushing SBOM now.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] action=canary_update release=r3.14-hotpatch regions=[eu-west-1] traffic=1% status=paused_pending_scan

Maya: tagging legal & security for audit trail: @Nitya @legal. attaching mitigation note: "hotpatch pins vulnerable lib to patched 2.0.1; artifacts signed; CI vuln scan passed locally; will monitor canary logs for anomalous parse errors."

Nitya (security): scanner returned: OK — no findings for CVE-2026-9999 on pinned artifact. I reviewed signatures. security +1. recommend 30m watch then resume rollout with gradual 5x steps.

Zoe (product): agreed. hold public release notes until 30m watch completes.

Liam: starting 30m watch, will escalate immediately on errors. rollout resume plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m pauses.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] status=canary_watch release=r3.14-hotpatch watch_window=30m owner=Liam

Maya: assigning follow-ups: Liam = rollout owner, Maya = SBOM + audit logs, Nitya = security approval, Zoe = comms.

Oncall Bot: change-window extended by 1h (approved).

Liam: noted. thanks all. will update thread with each step/status. :thumbsup:
